text:
Maya (Marketing): Hey all, new draft for the launch post is live: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/launch-draft-06
Maya (Marketing): Main asks: 1) final sign-off on benchmarks language, 2) pick hero quote, 3) confirm webinar CTA + routing. Planning publish Thu 04/14 09:00 PT (embargo until 04/13 10:00 for EA).
Rui (SEO): Nice draft. Suggest a 1-line TL;DR under the hero for OG: "Predictable, high-throughput LLM inference for production apps." Also shorten headline to "Predictable LLM inference at production scale".
Leo (Design): Can someone confirm image for hero? Options: infra diagram or product screenshot. I prefer screenshot with overlayed latency/cost callout.
Olivia (Product): Bench copy: changed "4x" to "up to 3.8x lower per-token cost in our tests" and added P50/P95 rows. Please keep comparisons non-branded (use "common open baseline").
Jonah (Legal): I need: a) methodology blurb, b) test scripts and raw results, and c) an explicit one-line caveat: "Results reflect internal workloads and may vary on customer data." Also remove any language implying direct customer comparisons.
Marvin (Ops): Uploaded artifacts: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/launch/benchmarks/results-2026-04-01.csv and anonymized: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/launch/benchmarks/results-2026-04-01-anon.csv
Maya (Marketing): Thanks. Methodology paragraph is in the draft under "How we measured". I'll insert Jonah's exact caveat sentence.
Sam (Growth): Webinar details: 04/15 10am PT. Speakers: Alex (CTO) + Priya (Customer). CTA should go to /events/llm-inference-launch with HubSpot form id hs_form_launch_0414. UTM source=blog, campaign=launch_apr. Nora, can events page be live by EOD Tue?
Nora (Events): Yep, landing page will be live. I'll wire the form id and test submissions.
Rui (SEO): Meta description suggestion: "Reduce inference cost and keep latency predictable — Redwood Inference helps engineering teams ship LLM features faster."
Leo (Design): Hero image ready. I'll add an alt tag: "Console screenshot showing request latency and cost metrics".
Jonah (Legal): Reviewing anonymized CSV. Two small asks: 1) redact any residual IP/host headers in the anon CSV, 2) don't use absolute superlatives in hero (e.g., remove "cheapest"). After that, legal sign-off ready.
Olivia (Product): Small technical tweak: change "streaming support" note to "streaming responses with function call support" — more accurate.
Maya (Marketing): Made edits: updated hero to avoid superlatives, added Jonah's caveat, swapped in Alex hero quote: "We build inference tools so teams can reliably ship AI features with predictable cost and latency."
Jonah (Legal): Quote looks fine. Confirmed anon CSV is clean. I'm good to sign-off pending one final copy pass.
Sam (Growth): Quick check: embargo schedule OK? EA notify 04/13 10am PT, public 04/14 09:00 PT. Webinar 04/15. Works for GTM.
Marvin (Ops): test command noted in footnote: ```python run_bench.py --model candidate --seq 1024 --rep 5 --capture_p95```
Maya (Marketing): Final draft pushed: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/launch-draft-06-v2. Tagging for final thumbs. Please reply with "ok" when you approve so I can schedule the publish.
Sam (Growth): ok
Olivia (Product): ok
Rui (SEO): ok
Nora (Events): ok
Jonah (Legal): ok
Leo (Design): ok
Marvin (Ops): ok
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — scheduling publish and wiring HubSpot after EOD sign-off. :tada:
